final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT p.player_id AS pid, COUNT(m.player_id) AS c FROM player p LEFT JOIN manager_award m ON m.player_id = p.player_id GROUP BY p.player_id), s2 AS (SELECT SUM(c) AS total FROM s1) SELECT s1.pid, s1.c, CASE WHEN s2.total = 0 THEN NULL ELSE CAST(s1.c AS REAL) / s2.total END AS ratio FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.total IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ratio DESC LIMIT 10
